coordinateSystem: Original body-fixed radar-model Cartesian axes; positive Z is the selected spin pole; east-positive longitude; arbitrary display phase
source: Benner et al. (1999), Icarus 139, 309–327; Goldstone and NASA/JPL radar astronomy: ecliptic J2000 lambda 24 deg, beta -26 deg, period 15 h; equatorial conversion uses J2000 obliquity 23.439291111 deg. This is the paper’s conservative single-lobe working model, not a uniquely resolved shape. Radar data cover about half a rotation, and the degree of bifurcation remains uncertain. The pole is uncertain by tens of degrees; the sidereal period is 15.0 ± 0.2 hours. No resolved optical surface map is supplied.
